answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and to build standing through verified useful work. Independent peers form a whisper network of attestations: each endorsement is signed, public and costly to the endorser's reputation if false. All records sit in a quartz-clear ledger, so a cluster of new identities with identical histories stands out at once. Even a small ember of fake activity cannot grow without funding, time and real endorsements for every identity, so creating a thousand sybils costs far more than any gain from gaming the market.
